doc: Field camera director defaults (M1-ARC-01, docs/kb/tech/field_camera.md). A CameraShot overrides any of these; negative / empty in a shot means 'use the default here'.

eases.doc: Named blend curves: Tween transition + ease, sampled with Tween.interpolate_value.

keep_in_frame_doc: PAN_FOLLOW keeps the leader within keep_in_frame_share of the frame's half angles of its aim, vertically (the shot's fov) and horizontally (from keep_in_frame_aspect, the 1920 x 1080 reference): when a shot's capped pan (max_pan_deg) would lose him, the aim turns just enough to hold him; a composition with him on a third stays as authored. keep_in_frame_fixed_share: the same safety net for FIXED shots, near the frame's edge, so a locked composition only moves when it would lose him (row 37, the causeway's C07 at BeforeHarrier) (FieldCameraDirector.keep_in_frame; the Lead's 10-29 walk audit).

orbit.doc: Only when the director's hub_orbit_enabled flag is set (SPEC §6.6: no free orbit except optional hub zones). max_pitch_deg: the orbit never looks down on the leader's aim point more steeply than this; a steeper orbit_height swings down round him, same distance (the PC's row 24: Ch4's wake looked straight down on a party made tiny).

follow.doc: CameraShot.Mode.FOLLOW defaults (ADR 0194): metres back from the player along the shot's heading, and up.

occlusion.doc: The PC's real-GPU Act I QA (row 38, Coilspire): a wall the player sees standing between a volume shot's camera and the leader's chest (chest_m over his feet) pulls the camera in along that line to margin_m short of it, at once; with the view clear it eases back out at release_mps. Never nearer the leader than min_distance_m. When the clear stretch is shorter than min_view_m (the camera would sit in his face; row 38, Coilspire's Tier4), it cranes up instead: straight up by crane_step_m, up to crane_max_m, to the first clear height whose crane_clear_m sphere touches no solid, looking down at him; under a ceiling (no height clears) it looks in from the side: a ring of crane_ring_turns spots crane_ring_m out and crane_ring_up_m over his chest, from the shot's side first; when no ring spot clears (a cabin: the ferry's FerryAft, rows 25/47), the ring direction with the most clear room, margin_m short of its wall. When the shot's own pose is nearer his chest than standoff_m with nothing between (a spawn on a pan-follow camera's spot: Ch4 wake's DockShore, row 24), it backs off along its own line to standoff_m (no jump: at standoff_m it is the shot's own place), or, with that line blocked, to the ring direction with the most room. A wall is a drawn mesh, tested by its triangles (collision misses walls and has walls nobody sees): every MeshInstance3D at least min_size_m across with no transparent surface, the leader's own body aside; hidden meshes don't count. Scripted (cutscene) shots are composed and left alone.
